diagnosis: Strong Google presence (50 reviews, 4.9★) but zero web footprint—no website to convert inbound leads or showcase credentials. Missing owned digital asset, forcing all traffic to Maps listing.
hero_angle: Highly-rated electrician with massive Google credibility but no website capturing the leads their reviews generate.
cold_message: Hey — 50 five-star reviews on Google is legit. But when someone in Denver, CO searches "electrician near me" tonight, they're booking whoever has a website. You're losing jobs to guys with half your reputation. Worth a quick fix? — Dave, Trevo Advisors
